  position: absolute; /* Position the bubble */

  justify-content: center; /* Center the checkmark */
}

.cyan-bullets li::after {
  content: "\2714"; /* Unicode for a thicker checkmark */
  position: absolute; /* Position the checkmark */
  left: 0.40em; /* Adjust based on the bubble size */
  top: 50%; /* Center the checkmark vertically */
  transform: translateY(-50%); /* Center the checkmark vertically */
  color: #1e3a8a; /* Checkmark color */
  font-size: 0.8em; /* Reduced size of the checkmark */
  font-weight: bold; /* Make the checkmark thicker */
}

  list-style: none; /* Ensure list style is none for list items */

  position: absolute; /* Position the bubble */

  align-items: center; /* Center the checkmark */
  justify-content: center; /* Center the checkmark */
}

.cyan-bullets li::after {
  content: "\2714"; /* Unicode for a thicker checkmark */
  position: absolute; /* Position the checkmark */
  left: 0.40em; /* Adjust based on the bubble size */
  top: 50%; /* Center the checkmark vertically */
  transform: translateY(-50%); /* Center the checkmark vertically */

  font-size: 0.8em; /* Reduced size of the checkmark */
  font-weight: bold; /* Make the checkmark thicker */
}

<script>
(function () {
	var panels = [
		document.getElementById('mdr-dashboard-alerts'),
		document.getElementById('mdr-dashboard-endpoints'),
		document.getElementById('mdr-dashboard-activity'),
	];
	if (!panels[0]) return;

	var dashboard = document.getElementById('mdr-dashboard');
	var main      = document.getElementById('mdr-dashboard-main');
	var ACTIVE_DURATION = 4000; // ms each panel stays active
	var FADE_OUT        = 1000; // ms to match message fade-out transition
	var current = 0;
	var timer   = null;

	// Once the main panel's intro animation ends, clear the forwards-fill so
	// inline styles can later override opacity (animation fill overrides CSS).
	if (main) {
		main.addEventListener('animationend', function () {
			main.style.opacity   = '1';
			main.style.animation = 'none';
		}, { once: true });
	}

	function activate(index) {
		// Fade out current message first, then switch
		panels.forEach(function (p) { p.classList.remove('active'); });
		panels[index].classList.add('active');
		current = (index + 1) % panels.length;
		timer = setTimeout(function () {
			panels[index].classList.remove('active');
			setTimeout(function () { activate(current); }, FADE_OUT);
		}, ACTIVE_DURATION);
	}

	// Start after all panels have finished their intro animation
	var introEnd = 0.9 + 0.55 + 0.2; // last delay + duration + buffer (seconds)
	setTimeout(function () {
		if (dashboard) dashboard.classList.add('started');
		if (main) {
			main.style.transition = 'opacity 1s ease';
			main.style.opacity    = '0.3';
		}
		activate(0);
	}, introEnd * 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function() {
	var accordion = document.getElementById('plAccordion');
	var scene = document.getElementById('plScene');
	if (!accordion || !scene) return;

	var items = accordion.querySelectorAll('.pl-item');

	items.forEach(function(item) {
		var trigger = item.querySelector('.pl-trigger');
		trigger.addEventListener('click', function() {
			var layer = item.dataset.layer;
			var isActive = item.classList.contains('active');

			/* Close all */
			items.forEach(function(i) {
				i.classList.remove('active');
				i.querySelector('.pl-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
			});

			/* Open clicked (always keep one open) */
			if (!isActive) {
				item.classList.add('active');
				trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
				scene.dataset.active = layer;
			} else {
				/* Re-clicking active keeps it open */
				item.classList.add('active');
				trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
			}
		});
	});

	/* Also allow clicking layers in the graphic */
	scene.querySelectorAll('.pl-layer').forEach(function(layerEl) {
		layerEl.addEventListener('click', function() {
			var classes = layerEl.className;
			var match = classes.match(/pl-layer--(\w+)/);
			if (!match) return;
			var layerName = match[1];

			items.forEach(function(i) {
				i.classList.remove('active');
				i.querySelector('.pl-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
			});

			var target = accordion.querySelector('[data-layer="' + layerName + '"]');
			if (target) {
				target.classList.add('active');
				target.querySelector('.pl-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
				scene.dataset.active = layerName;
			}
		});
	});
})();
</script>

.cyan-bullets {
  list-style-type: none; /* Remove default bullets */

.cyan-bullets ul,
.cyan-bullets ol {
  list-style-type: none; /* Ensure nested lists also do not show bullets */
}

.cyan-bullets li {
  position: relative; /* Position relative for pseudo-element */
  padding-left: 2.5rem; /* Space for the checkmark */
  margin-bottom: 1.1rem; /* Space between list items */
  list-style: none; /* Ensure list style is none for list items */
}

.cyan-bullets li::before {
  content: ""; /* Empty content for the bubble */
  position: absolute; /* Position the bubble */
  left: 0; /* Align the bubble with the text */
  top: 50%; /* Center the bubble vertically */
  transform: translateY(-50%); /* Center the bubble vertically */
  width: 1.7em; /* Size of the bubble */
  height: 1.7em; /* Size of the bubble */
  background-color: #83f0f8; /* Bubble color */
  border-radius: 50%; /* Circular shape */
  display: flex; /* Center the checkmark */
  align-items: center; /* Center the checkmark */
  justify-content: center; /* Center the checkmark */
}

.cyan-bullets li::after {
  content: "\2714"; /* Unicode for a thicker checkmark */
  position: absolute; /* Position the checkmark */
  left: 0.40em; /* Adjust based on the bubble size */
  top: 50%; /* Center the checkmark vertically */
  transform: translateY(-50%); /* Center the checkmark vertically */
  color: #1e3a8a; /* Checkmark color */
  font-size: 0.8em; /* Reduced size of the checkmark */
  font-weight: bold; /* Make the checkmark thicker */
}

}
